question: Paano kinukwenta ang zoning fee at filing fee para sa Locational Clearance ng 2-storey building sa CPDO?
answer:
Wala akong nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin sa Citizens' Charter tungkol sa zoning fee at filing fee para sa Locational Clearance ng 2-storey building sa CPDO.

However, sa [S2], nakatanggap ang 2-storey buildings at building floor area of 1,500 square meters and below ng validation ng Occupancy Permit, hindi nakit-an ang zoning fee at filing fee.

Sa [S1] at [S3], nakatanggap ang mga 2-storey buildings ng Locational Clearance, pero wala rin nakit-an ang zoning fee at filing fee.

Sa wakas, hindi natagalpa sa Citizens' Charter ang impormasyon tungkol sa zoning fee at filing fee para sa Locational Clearance ng 2-storey building sa CPDO. Itaas ang inyong ulat sa CPDO upang malaman ang mga kailangang bayad.

[S2] City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-3.pdf | printed page 637 | chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0008-C001
[S3] City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-3.pdf | printed page 640 | chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0011-C001

ground_truth:
For Locational Clearance for Building Permit for 2-storey and below, the zoning fee is 1/10 of 1% of building cost for agricultural/residential and commercial/industrial/institutional categories. Filing fees are PHP150 per application for agricultural/residential and PHP300 per application for commercial/industrial.

The Map Plotting step separately lists a PHP300 filing fee, with order of payment issued by OBO. The TOTAL row lists 4 Days, 2 Hours, and 25 Minutes. The source does not explicitly list an institutional filing fee or explain aggregation of the map-plotting charge in the TOTAL row.
